subject: POC sprint-zero: environment dependencies & owners (draft MAP milestone)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@gridlytics.com>, GridLytics Platform Team <platform@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC sprint-zero: environment dependencies & owners (draft MAP milestone)

Hi Sarah / GridLytics team —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discovery, we sketched a draft MAP milestone for the POC environment setup ("sprint-zero") so both teams are aligned on owners, blockers and a realistic target close. Please see the asks and proposed owners below and reply with confirmations or edits.

Summary (goal): get a sandbox POC environment where Redwood inference nodes can reach your VPC and authenticate via your SSO for a limited pilot. Target close (proposal): 2027-07-21.

Key dependencies & immediate asks:
- VPC peering / routing: GridLytics platform to provision a peering connection and confirm accepted CIDR ranges. (Owner: GridLytics Platform)
- IP allowlists / egress ranges: need static egress ranges or NAT IPs to whitelist; provide final list of public IPs for token-exchange and webhook callbacks. (Owner: GridLytics Security)
- SSO / SAML: we need SAML metadata XML and a test SP/IDP config for staging; provide IdP cert and ACS URL confirmation. (Owner: GridLytics SSO admin)
- Secrets / KMS: confirm whether you will provide a customer-managed KMS key for encrypting secrets (preferred) or want Redwood-managed keys; include KMS key alias and IAM binding that allows Redwood service account to decrypt. (Owner: GridLytics Security/KMS)
- Network ACLs & ports: open TCP 443 and 22 (for an optional jumpbox), confirm any proxy requirements. (Owner: GridLytics Platform)

Proposed short milestones (sprint-zero):
1) 07/07 — provide SAML metadata + IdP cert (deliverable: sso-metadata.xml) — GridLytics
2) 07/09 — provide static egress IP list / NAT IPs and CIDR acceptance for peering — GridLytics
3) 07/14 — peering established and smoke-tested by both teams — GridLytics + Redwood
4) 07/16 — secrets/KMS configuration confirmed and test secret exchange validated — GridLytics + Redwood
5) 07/21 — POC validation window complete, sign-off on environment readiness (target close) — All

Risks / open questions:
- If GridLytics cannot provide static egress IPs we will need to discuss proxying options which could add ~1 week.
- KMS policy changes may require your infra change window; please flag maintenance windows.

Attachments: I attached a draft milestones sheet for quick edits (poc-milestones-draft.xlsx).

Proposed next step: please confirm owners and the SAML metadata timeline by EOD Friday (07/02). If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical alignment with Karthik and your platform lead.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@gridlytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: GridLytics Platform Team <platform@gridlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC sprint-zero: environment dependencies & owners (draft MAP milestone)

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. We did a quick internal sync and assigning initial owners: Miguel Torres (platform) will own peering and ACLs; I'm owning SSO/SAML collection and will coordinate with security for KMS.

Quick answers / next steps from our side:
- SAML metadata: I attached the IdP metadata (sso-metadata.xml) and Miguel will follow up on the ACS and cert details by 07/05.
- Egress IPs: we can provide NAT gateway public IPs but need to confirm whether Redwood needs a fixed source IP per cluster or per-region. We'll provide the full list by 07/09.
- KMS: security prefers to use GridLytics-managed keys; we'll provide the key alias and minimal IAM roles for the Redwood service account. Miguel will include those details by 07/12.

We have a scheduling conflict the week of 07/05 (internal go-live for another team), so Miguel proposed a short technical call on 07/08 to hammer details. Does that work for your team?

Thanks —
Sarah Connors
Head of Partnerships
GridLytics

Attachment: sso-metadata.xml (IdP metadata)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@gridlytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint-zero: environment dependencies & owners (draft MAP milestone)

Thanks Sarah — quick technical clarifications from our infra side so the team can build the MAP more accurately: 

1) IP allowlists: if you provide NAT gateway public IPs that is sufficient. We prefer a fixed set per test cluster; please include whether there are per-region differences. Example format we need: 3.22.45.100/32, 54.210.11.5/32.

2) VPC peering: we'll need the peer CIDR and a route table entry for our serving subnet. If you have a preferred CIDR for peering acceptance list, send it over. We will coordinate firewall rules on our side.

3) SAML: metadata looks good. For SP config, our ACS URL for staging is: https://staging-auth.redwoodinference.com/saml/acs. We will provide a temporary SP cert if you need it.

4) KMS: Grid-managed key is fine. Please provide the key resource name/alias and add the following principal to the key policy: serviceAccount:redwood-infra@redwood-prod. Once we have the alias we can run an encrypt/decrypt test.

5) Test window: to minimize risk to both teams we propose the smoke test window 07/14–07/16. That gives us time after your 07/08 technical call to implement.

I'll upload a small milestone workbook with the specific owner columns and expected deliverables (poc-milestones-draft.xlsx). If GridLytics prefers a different owner mapping let us know.

—Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@gridlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@gridlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint-zero: environment dependencies & owners (draft MAP milestone)

Great — appreciate the quick confirmations. Updated plan / immediate asks consolidated below (this will become the MAP milestone once we have the two outstanding deliverables):

Outstanding deliverables we need to lock in:
- Final SAML metadata + IdP cert (Sarah) — due 2027-07-05 (Sarah -> delivered 07/01, thanks)
- NAT/public egress IP list (Miguel) — due 2027-07-09
- KMS key alias + grant (Security) — initial info due 2027-07-12
- Technical alignment call scheduled: 2027-07-08 10:00 PT (30 min) — attendees: Miguel, Sarah, Karthik, Ben, Jordan
- Smoke test window: 2027-07-14 through 2027-07-16

Target close: 2027-07-21 (POC environment sign-off). If any item slips beyond the KMS decision we will shift the sign-off window and flag impact to timeline immediately.

I will convert the workbook to a shareable MAP milestone table and send an updated link after the 07/08 call. Thanks everyone — looking forward to the call.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
